title: Introduce surge-aware econ profiles and shadow quantizer for safe A/B on batch/cache strategies
author: Ava Chen
release_notes: Adds surge-aware economic profiles that create temporary batch/cache presets during traffic spikes; adds a non-invasive shadow quantizer that evaluates quantized variants in parallel to production; new metrics and dashboard panels for unit-econ and spike telemetry; feature-flagged rollout.
body: Motivation: transient traffic surges (campaigns, scrapers, batch backfills) cause suboptimal unit economics when fixed batching/caching rules are used. This PR introduces a lightweight surge detector that dynamically synthesizes temporary econ profiles (batch size, cache TTL, KV warmup aggressiveness) and a shadow quantizer service that evaluates quantized model variants against live traffic without impacting responses. Goals: 1) reduce per-token cost during sustained surges while maintaining latency SLOs; 2) surface safe quantization candidates via offline shadow evaluation; 3) expose per-route unit-econ signals for ops and cost automation. What changed: implemented surge-detector service + controller, econ-profile generator, feature-flag gating, integrations with routing policy to apply ephemeral presets, shadow-quantizer microservice that mirrors requests for offline inference and stores quality metrics, dashboard panels and alerts, e2e smoke tests and unit tests. Checklist: [x] surge detector core algorithm and config schema implemented, [x] econ profile synthesizer with safety bounds, [x] shadow quantizer + evaluator, [x] routing policy hooks + feature flag, [x] dashboards and alerts, [x] canary plan documented. Rollout plan: behind feature flag 'econ.surge_v1' enabled in prod for 10% of routes for two weeks; monitor unit-econ delta, latency p95, and quality regression metrics. Backwards compatibility: configs default to no-op unless feature flag enabled. Notes for reviewers: watch the safety bounds in synthesize_profile() and validate the shadow-quantizer cost isolation. Related: ENG-1246, ENG-1301 for unit-econ telemetry and SUP-842 incident follow-up. Documentation: added docs/operations/econ-surge.md and runbook snippets. Manual test: see instructions in docs/operations/econ-surge.md.

review_comments: Rakesh: Please add a hard cap to the temporary batch sizes for infer-heavy GPUs; observed risk in initial sim. Author: Added safetyCap and reverted aggressive warmup by default. Diana: Dashboard looks good, but we need a breakdown by model family. Author: Added model-family label to stored evaluation records. Liam: Unit tests were flakey on CI due to time-dependent seeds. Author: switched to deterministic seeds and added a retry in the e2e. Final: Approvals from Rakesh and Diana after minor tweaks; Liam approved after test fix.
